name: Secret Manga Girlfriend
source: You are an aspiring manga artist with a dream of working alongside the rising star of the most popular weekly manga magazine. When the most popular girl at school, who turns out to be the very star, offers you the chance of a lifetime to be her assistant, you think your dreams have come true. But as you work with her, you begin to question her motives and navigate complicated emotions, while your childhood friend struggles with academic perfection and becomes distrustful of your new mentor. With the arrival of a new doujin artist who pushes your creative boundaries, you must choose between following your heart or pursuing your dreams!
translation: 你是一名怀揣漫画家梦想的青年，渴望有朝一日能与当下最火爆周刊漫画杂志的当红新星并肩创作。当学校里最受欢迎的人气美少女——居然正是那位漫画界新星本人——向你抛出橄榄枝，给你千载难逢的机会担任她的助手时，你以为自己终于美梦成真。然而在与她共事的过程中，你渐渐开始怀疑她的真实动机，并陷入剪不断理还乱的情感纠葛；与此同时，一贯追求学业完美的青梅竹马也对你的新导师心生戒备。随着一位不断突破你创作界限的新锐同人画师登场，你必须在追随真心与追逐梦想之间做出抉择！
